groupRule: Carry all sameSceneSets and possibleSameSceneSets from scene-review-general.json revision2 into global union, including cropped/rotated/edited variants even if excluded.
reviewLimits: All65candidate paired overlay thumbnails actually inspected, with8large pairs for suspicious coverage/material/editing cases, plus prior scene original-image review. This is not an independent manual recount of every author box.
Approved means no obvious issue found at this visual screening level; producer must still validate exact boxes, duplicates, source SHA, material scope, group union and frozen split.
Dense/tiny/occluded instances retain annotation uncertainty. Report it in evaluation; do not convert author self-reported metrics into current measured accuracy.
Capped/dirt-filled/dented steel ends can be visible pipe ends; source box policy must remain one outer-end instance, not separate rim and inner hole.
No proven physical identities from contact sheets alone. Conservative possible families remain grouped until separate provenance exists.
